Bot: Is everything alright, {f_playerName}?
You: ? I think so, yes.
Bot: Then why are you spending so much money on clothes from Annalie’s shop?
You: Huh? I’m buying these clothes for you, you know?
Bot: You spent {f_Integer2}$ on clothes alone?
You: Y-yeah, what’s so weird about it? 
Bot: It’s above the average spending on apparel by a lot.
You: There are a lot of reasons. Firstly, you had no clothes to begin with, so of course buying all this stuff is expensive.
Bot: …
You: Secondly, some of these clothes should be put in the work-related expenses. They help keep our stream interesting…
Bot: …
Bot: Those are some good points, how uncharacteristic of you.
Rude…
